in_sanskrit.name: योगिन्देर
in_sanskrit.meaning: Jñāna-yoga-guru, teacher of knowledge and yoga
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ज्ञान (Jñāna) - knowledge, योग (Yoga) - union, देर (Der) - giver, ज्ञान-योग-गुरु (Jñāna-yoga-guru) - teacher of knowledge and yoga

in_hindi.name: योगिन्देर
in_hindi.meaning: ज्ञान-पालन (Jñāna-pālan) - guardian of knowledge, ज्ञान-दाता (Jñāna-dātā) - giver of knowledge
in_hindi.long_meaning: योग (Yoga) - union, इंद्र (Inder) - lord, ज्ञान-पालन (Jñāna-pālan) - guardian of knowledge, ज्ञान-दाता (Jñāna-dātā) - giver of knowledge

in_tamil.name: யோகிந்தேர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜ்ஜானம் (Jñānam) - knowledge, யோகம் (Yogam) - union, தேர் (Ther) - giver, ஜ்ஜான யோக களவும், ஜ்ஜான அழகியவர் (Jñāna yōga kāḷavum, Jñāna aṝakiyar) - one who unites knowledge with yoga and one who is the giver of knowledge

in_telugu.name: యోగిన్దేర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: జ్ఞానము (Jñānamu) - knowledge, యోగము (Yogamu) - union, దేశి (Dēśi) - one who resides, జ్ఞాన యోగ దేశి (Jñāna yōga dēśi), జ్ఞాన దేశి (Jñāna dēśi) - one who resides in knowledge and union

in_marathi.name: Yoginder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yoginder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yogi (practitioner of yoga) + Indra (God of rain, thunder, and storms)

in_bengali.name: Yoginder
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Divine Inder (God)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yoginder একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Yogi (practitioner of yoga) + Indra (God of rain, thunder, and storms)
